entries.title: James 5:1
segments: ¶Come now, [you] rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming upon [you]!

entries.title: James 5:2
segments: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.

entries.title: James 5:3
segments: Your gold and silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be a witness against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have heaped up treasure in the last days.

entries.title: James 5:4
segments: Indeed the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of the reapers have reached the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth.

entries.title: James 5:5
segments: You have lived on the earth in pleasure and luxury; you have fattened your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

entries.title: James 5:6
segments: You have condemned, you have murdered the just; he does not resist you.

entries.title: James 5:7
segments: Therefore be patient, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. See [how] the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, waiting patiently for it until it receives the early and latter rain.

entries.title: James 5:8
segments: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

entries.title: James 5:9
segments: Do not grumble against one another, brethren, lest you be condemned. Behold, the Judge is standing at the door!

entries.title: James 5:10
segments: My brethren, take the prophets, who spoke in the name of the Lord, as an example of suffering and patience.

entries.title: James 5:11
segments: Indeed we count them blessed who endure. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and seen the end [intended by] the Lord--that the Lord is very compassionate and merciful.

entries.title: James 5:12
segments: ¶But above all, my brethren, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or with any other oath. But let your "Yes," be "Yes," and [your] "No," "No," lest you fall into judgment.

entries.title: James 5:13
segments: Is anyone among you suffering? Let him pray. Is anyone cheerful? Let him sing psalms.

entries.title: James 5:14
segments: Is anyone among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

entries.title: James 5:15
segments: And the prayer of faith will save the sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

entries.title: James 5:16
segments: Confess [your] trespasses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The effective, fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.

entries.title: James 5:17
segments: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it would not rain; and it did not rain on the land for three years and six months.

entries.title: James 5:18
segments: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

entries.title: James 5:19
segments: Brethren, if anyone among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back,

entries.title: James 5:20
segments: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and cover a multitude of sins.
